question: What are the names of distinct racing bikes that are purchased by the cyclists with better results than '4:21.558' ?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "bikes" AS SELECT "id" AS "id", "weight" AS "weight", "price" AS "price", "product_material" AS "product_material" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "cyclists" AS SELECT "id" AS "id", "name" AS "name", "nation" AS "nation", "heat_result" AS "heat_result" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "purchases" AS SELECT "cid" AS "cid", "bike_id" AS "bike_id", "py" AS "py" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE threshold AS
SELECT 4 * 60 + 21.558 AS thresh_seconds

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH parsed_cyclists AS (
    SELECT 
        id AS cyclist_id,
        name,
        nation,
        -- Extract substring after the last '-' if present, else the whole string
        CASE WHEN instr(heat_result, '-') > 0 THEN substr(heat_result, instr(heat_result, '-') + 1)
             ELSE heat_result END AS time_str
    FROM cyclists
), time_seconds AS (
    SELECT 
        cyclist_id,
        name,
        nation,
        -- Parse mm:ss.mmm into total seconds
        CAST(split_part(time_str, ':', 1) AS DOUBLE) * 60 
          + CAST(split_part(time_str, ':', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS seconds
    FROM parsed_cyclists
), bike_names AS (
    SELECT 
        id AS bike_id,
        -- Take part before '###' as the name; trim spaces
        trim(split_part(product_material, '###', 1)) AS bike_name
    FROM bikes
)
SELECT DISTINCT bn.bike_name
FROM time_seconds ts
JOIN purchases p ON p.cid = ts.cyclist_id
JOIN bike_names bn ON bn.bike_id = p.bike_id
CROSS JOIN threshold t
WHERE ts.seconds < t.thresh_seconds
ORDER BY bn.bike_name
